title.zh: 【美股下挫：标普 500 与纳指跌至 7 月下旬以来低位，加密概念股普跌】

current_state.zh: US equity indices suffered a steep selloff, with the S&P 500 down 2.79% and Nasdaq 100 down 4.81% to their lowest levels since late July, dragging crypto-related stocks down roughly 9-12% across the board.
